items.title: 52193_Jay McShann oral history interview
items.q: Tim Gail came in and caught us at Gary and he sat and we talked

ctx.x: The success of the blues, would that have been partly responsible for Moe Gale wanting you to go to the Savoy -- how come that you went --

Well, I wouldn't say that was primarily the whole cause. I think it was because we went to the Savoy, he sent his brother out, Tim Gail to hear the band at Gary, Indiana, and we were on our way to New York.
